title: State refresh
author: Soundwave, Chief of Staff
body: STATE.md now matches PRs #8–#13: the built-in-bot viewer is live, CI verifies committed web/pkg, the simulations org stays the old org, engine docs live in docs/engine/, and replay format 3 records setup_hash.
next: GATE-002 awaits the founder's APPROVE; then Blitzwing builds tank rules, followed by a gated Saltmarsh MuJoCo world. The company-site draft is unpublished while Nye chooses a logo; the Bevy 3D viewer is future work, not scheduled.
